method.complete: Seven alternating fresh processes per variant/case; >=0.4 seconds and >=3 calls per process. Parsing, external checks, serialization untimed; internal allocation, reconstruction and acceptance checks timed. No concurrent compiler/runtime workload.
method.recording: All independent process medians retained with within-process count/range/percentiles/MAD. Individual call arrays remain in .cache/gcd-cofactor-simd/complete.json. Microbenchmarks retain every process measurement.
method.profiling: Whole-process SIGPROF self samples, nominal 1ms CPU interval. Generic specializations aggregated by qualified function name here; raw symbol labels and PC samples remain in the scratch profile records. Inlining affects attribution. Profiled timings are not benchmark comparisons.
method.micro: 0 original scalar arithmetic; 1 new scalar reduction; 2 SIMD with production cutoffs. Compiler optimizations permitted in every control. Same inputs/repetitions; preparation excluded. Brown original uses raw pointers matching production.
method.scope: Private native producers and their existing consumers; no new resultant dispatch integration.

import concurrent.futures,json,os,sys,threading
from pathlib import Path
folder=Path.cwd()/'.cache/resultant-cofactor-commit';root=folder/'staged'
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
from build_state import prepared_build
from test_executable import prepare,run
report={'scope':'Exact staged source tree, excluding unrelated uncommitted work. Five targeted programs at O3; new cofactor program also at O0.','variants':[]};lock=threading.Lock()
def save():
    with lock:(folder/'validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
with prepared_build(root/'build') as snapshot:
    def execute(flags,names,cpu):
        os.sched_setaffinity(0,set(cpu))
        programs=[root/'tests/polynomials'/(p+'.mojo') for p in names]
        executable=prepare(programs,snapshot,root,flags=flags,cache=folder/'tests',timeout=1200,compiler_threads=len(cpu))
        variant={'optimization':flags[0],'executable':executable.report(),'results':[]}
        with lock:report['variants'].append(variant)
        save()
        for path in programs:
            result=run(['taskset','-c',str(cpu[0]),str(executable.binary),str(executable.programs.index(path))],root,1200)
            variant['results'].append(dict(program=str(path.relative_to(root)),**result));save()
            print(flags[0],path.name,result['returncode'],result['seconds'],result['stdout'][-250:],result['stderr'][-250:],flush=True)
            if result['returncode']!=0:raise RuntimeError(str(path)+' failed')
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
        jobs=[pool.submit(execute,['-O3'],['test_resultant_cofactor_simd','test_resultant','test_cad_projection','test_cad_field_sturm','test_cad_field_extension'],[0,1]),pool.submit(execute,['-O0'],['test_resultant_cofactor_simd'],[2,3])]
        for job in concurrent.futures.as_completed(jobs):job.result()
print('STAGED TREE TESTS PASS',flush=True)

import hashlib,json,os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();folder=root/'.cache/resultant-cofactor-commit';tree=folder/'staged'
old=json.loads((folder/'archive/modular-gcd-cofactor-simd-2026-10-24.json').read_text())
def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def source(path):return {'sha256':sha(path),'text':path.read_text()}
validation=json.loads((folder/'validation.json').read_text())
assert len(validation['variants'])==2 and sum(len(v['results']) for v in validation['variants'])==6
assert all(r['returncode']==0 for v in validation['variants'] for r in v['results'])
smoke=[]
for case in old['cases']:
    if not case['name'].startswith('cofactors-'):continue
    work=folder/'smoke'/case['name'];work.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    for label,record in case['inputs'].items():(work/(label+'.txt')).write_text(record['text'])
    cmd=[str(folder/'producer'),str(work/'f.txt'),str(work/'g.txt'),str(work/'answer.txt'),'0','1']
    result=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=60)
    assert (work/'answer.txt').read_text()==case['baseline_answer']['text'],case['name']
    smoke.append({'case':case['name'],'command':cmd,'answer_sha256':sha(work/'answer.txt'),'matches_independent_reference':True})
controls=[]
for kind in ['subtract','inverse']:
    for n in [7,8,17,128]:
        checksums=[]
        for mode in [0,1,2]:
            result=subprocess.run([str(folder/'kernels'),kind,str(n),'2147483659','100',str(mode)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=60)
            checksums.append(json.loads(result.stdout)['checksum'])
        assert len(set(checksums))==1,(kind,n)
        controls.append({'kind':kind,'length':n,'prime':2147483659,'repetitions':100,'checksums':checksums})
paths=['src/polynomials/_modular_simd.mojo','src/polynomials/_word_simd.mojo','src/polynomials/_unit_bezout.mojo','src/polynomials/_resultant_cofactors.mojo','tests/polynomials/test_resultant_cofactor_simd.mojo','benchmarks/drivers/poly_mojo/resultant_cofactors.mojo','benchmarks/drivers/poly_mojo/cofactor_simd.mojo']
for name in ['_brown_gcd','_sparse_brown']:
    p='src/polynomials/'+name+'.mojo'
    assert (root/p).read_bytes()==(tree/p).read_bytes()==subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:'+p])
for p in paths:
    assert (tree/p).read_bytes()==subprocess.check_output(['git','show',':'+p]),p
for p,expected in json.loads((folder/'preserved.json').read_text()).items():assert sha(root/p)==expected,p
measurements=[r for r in old['complete_operations']['results'] if r['case']['name'].startswith('cofactors-')]
for i,r in enumerate(measurements):
    if r['case']['name']=='cofactors-d8':measurements[i]=old['targeted_repeat']['results'][0]
record={
 'date':'2026-10-24','scope':'Resultant-cofactor SIMD only. Dense and sparse Brown sources match the parent commit. Other pending CAD, FGLM, NTT and modular-dot changes are excluded.',
 'parent_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),
 'committed_sources':{p:source(tree/p) for p in paths},
 'build':json.loads((tree/'build/library-build.json').read_text()),'validation':validation,
 'isolated_producer_checks':smoke,'isolated_kernel_controls':controls,
 'binaries':{n:{'sha256':sha(folder/n),'bytes':(folder/n).stat().st_size} for n in ['producer','kernels']},
 'prior_measurements':{'scope':'These timings precede removing the GCD experiment and unrelated pending changes from the commit. The accepted cofactor arithmetic is unchanged. The exact staged scope is independently built and checked above; no new speed claim is inferred from smoke-run timings.',
 'host':old['host'],'method':old['method'],'complete_operations':measurements,
 'kernels':[r for r in old['kernels']['results'] if r['kind'] in ['subtract','inverse']],
 'cases':[c for c in old['cases'] if c['name'].startswith('cofactors-')],
 'profiles':[r for r in old['profiles'] if r['case']['name'].startswith('cofactors-')],
 'independent_oracle':[r for r in old['independent_oracle'] if r['case'].startswith('cofactors-')]},
 'scripts':{'validation':(folder/'validate.py').read_text(),'record':Path(__file__).read_text()},
}
output=root/'benchmarks/results/resultant-cofactor-simd-2026-10-24.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
doc=root/'docs/proposals/resultant-cofactor-simd.md';s=doc.read_text();assert '<!-- VALIDATION -->' in s
test=next(r for v in validation['variants'] if v['optimization']=='-O3' for r in v['results'] if 'test_resultant_cofactor_simd' in r['program'])
summary='Validation passed for the exact staged tree:\n\n'
summary+='- The dedicated cofactor SIMD program at both `-O0` and `-O3`: `'+test['stdout'].strip()+'`.\n'
summary+='- Existing resultant, CAD projection, field Sturm, and field extension tests at `-O3`.\n'
summary+='- Three complete cofactor outputs match the independently checked reference resultants and both cofactors.\n'
summary+='- Original scalar, new scalar, and SIMD kernel controls agree at lengths 7, 8, 17, and 128.\n'
summary+='- Both Brown GCD source files match the parent commit; unrelated pending files retain their original contents.\n\n'
summary+='The [scope and validation record](../../benchmarks/results/resultant-cofactor-simd-2026-10-24.json) includes staged source snapshots, the build manifest, test results, independent reference inputs, kernel controls, and the earlier cofactor-only measurements.\n'
doc.write_text(s.replace('<!-- VALIDATION -->',summary))
print(test['stdout'].strip());print('ISOLATED SCOPE VERIFIED; record',output.stat().st_size,'bytes')
